description: Corrected discriminating test: C-terminal architecture of mtl3 versus experimentally confirmed CWI sensors and GPI cell wall proteins, using both a TM-strength scan (KD w=19) and a GPI-signal scan (KD w=11 in the last 40 residues); writes evidence matrix and topology comparison artifacts
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

panel = [
    ("O94317", "mtl3",  "S. pombe",      "query"),
    ("O13695", "mtl2",  "S. pombe",      "CWI sensor"),
    ("Q10153", "wsc1",  "S. pombe",      "CWI sensor"),
    ("P53214", "Mtl1",  "S. cerevisiae", "CWI sensor"),
    ("P36027", "Mid2",  "S. cerevisiae", "CWI sensor"),
    ("P54867", "Wsc1",  "S. cerevisiae", "CWI sensor"),
    ("P22146", "Gas1",  "S. cerevisiae", "GPI cell wall"),
    ("P28319", "Cwp1",  "S. cerevisiae", "GPI cell wall"),
    ("P53301", "Crh1",  "S. cerevisiae", "GPI cell wall"),
    ("Q8TFG9", "pfl2",  "S. pombe",      "GPI cell wall"),
    ("O13854", "adg2",  "S. pombe",      "GPI cell wall"),
]
KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}

def prof(seq, w):
    v = np.array([KD.get(a, 0.0) for a in seq])
    return np.convolve(v, np.ones(w)/w, mode="valid") if len(v) >= w else np.array([])

def segments(seq, w=19, thr=1.6):
    p = prof(seq, w); above = p > thr; segs=[]; i=0
    while i < len(above):
        if above[i]:
            j=i
            while j+1 < len(above) and above[j+1]: j+=1
            segs.append((i+1, j+w)); i=j+1
        else: i+=1
    return segs

rows=[]
for acc, sym, org, cls in panel:
    seq = "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=45).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
    L = len(seq)
    internal = [s for s in segments(seq) if s[0] > 30]          # TM-strength, excludes signal peptide
    # GPI-signal scan: softer, shorter window, restricted to the last 40 residues
    p11 = prof(seq, 11)
    tail_region = p11[max(0, L-40):]
    gpi_peak = float(tail_region.max()) if len(tail_region) else np.nan
    gpi_peak_pos = int(max(0, L-40) + int(np.argmax(tail_region)) + 1) if len(tail_region) else -1
    gpi_peak_end = gpi_peak_pos + 10
    res_after_gpi_peak = L - gpi_peak_end
    tm_tail = (L - internal[-1][1]) if internal else np.nan
    st = sum(seq.count(a) for a in "ST")/L*100
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc, symbol=sym, organism=org, cls=cls, length=L, ST_pct=round(st,1),
                     n_TM_strength_segments=len(internal),
                     last_TM_segment=("%d-%d"%internal[-1]) if internal else "none",
                     residues_after_last_TM=tm_tail,
                     cterm_KD_peak_w11=round(gpi_peak,2),
                     cterm_peak_window=f"{gpi_peak_pos}-{gpi_peak_end}",
                     residues_after_cterm_peak=res_after_gpi_peak))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("="*100)

q  = df[df.symbol=="mtl3"].iloc[0]
gpi = df[df.cls=="GPI cell wall"]
sen = df[df.cls=="CWI sensor"]

print("\nA. Residues after the last TM-strength hydrophobic segment (KD w=19 > 1.6, excluding signal peptide)")
print(f"   mtl3         : {q.residues_after_last_TM:.0f}")
print(f"   CWI sensors  : {dict(zip(sen.symbol, sen.residues_after_last_TM))}")
print(f"   GPI cell wall: {dict(zip(gpi.symbol, gpi.residues_after_last_TM))}  (NaN = no TM-strength segment at all)")
print(f"   every CWI sensor has >=21 residues after its TM; every GPI protein has 0 or no TM-strength segment")

print("\nB. Residues after the C-terminal hydrophobic peak (KD w=11, last 40 residues)")
a = gpi.residues_after_cterm_peak.astype(float); b = sen.residues_after_cterm_peak.astype(float)
print(f"   mtl3         : {q.residues_after_cterm_peak}")
print(f"   GPI cell wall: {list(a.astype(int))}  median {a.median():.0f}")
print(f"   CWI sensors  : {list(b.astype(int))}  median {b.median():.0f}")
u, p = mannwhitneyu(a, b, alternative="less")
print(f"   Mann-Whitney U (GPI < sensor): U={u:.1f}, p={p:.4f}, n={len(a)} vs {len(b)}")
print(f"   mtl3 value {q.residues_after_cterm_peak}: inside GPI range [{a.min():.0f},{a.max():.0f}] = "
      f"{a.min() <= q.residues_after_cterm_peak <= a.max()}; inside sensor range [{b.min():.0f},{b.max():.0f}] = "
      f"{b.min() <= q.residues_after_cterm_peak <= b.max()}")

print("\nC. C-terminal hydrophobic peak height (KD w=11)")
print(f"   mtl3 {q.cterm_KD_peak_w11}; GPI median {gpi.cterm_KD_peak_w11.median():.2f}; sensor median {sen.cterm_KD_peak_w11.median():.2f}")

# ---------- figure ----------
colmap={"query":"#c0392b","CWI sensor":"#2c7fb8","GPI cell wall":"#7fbf7b"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 4.8))

d = df.sort_values("residues_after_cterm_peak")
ax[0].barh(range(len(d)), d.residues_after_cterm_peak, color=[colmap[c] for c in d.cls])
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(d))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(d.symbol, fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residues after the C-terminal hydrophobic peak")
ax[0].set_title("mtl3 ends at its hydrophobic tail, as GPI proteins do", fontsize=10)
for i, (v, s) in enumerate(zip(d.residues_after_cterm_peak, d.symbol)):
    ax[0].text(v+3, i, f"{v:.0f}", va="center", fontsize=8, fontweight="bold" if s=="mtl3" else "normal")
ax[0].set_xlim(0, d.residues_after_cterm_peak.max()*1.18)

for c in ["CWI sensor","GPI cell wall","query"]:
    s_ = df[df.cls==c]
    ax[1].scatter(s_.ST_pct, s_.residues_after_cterm_peak, c=colmap[c], s=95, label=c, edgecolor="k", lw=0.5, zorder=3)
for _, r_ in df.iterrows():
    ax[1].annotate(r_.symbol, (r_.ST_pct, r_.residues_after_cterm_peak), fontsize=8, xytext=(4,4), textcoords="offset points")
ax[1].set_xlabel("Ser + Thr content (%)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("residues after C-terminal hydrophobic peak")
ax[1].set_title("Two features separate the classes; mtl3 sits with the GPI group", fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].grid(alpha=0.3, zorder=0)

# KD profile of mtl3 C-terminus vs Mtl1 (the protein mtl3 was named after)
for acc, sym, col in [("O94317","mtl3","#c0392b"), ("P53214","ScMtl1","#2c7fb8")]:
    seq = "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=45).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
    p = prof(seq, 19); x = np.arange(len(p)) + 10
    ax[2].plot(x/len(seq)*100, p, color=col, label=f"{sym} ({len(seq)} aa)", lw=1.4)
ax[2].axhline(1.6, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1)
ax[2].text(2, 1.75, "TM threshold 1.6", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax[2].set_xlabel("position (% of chain)"); ax[2].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle, window 19")
ax[2].set_title("ScMtl1 has an internal TM at 65-71%; mtl3 is hydrophobic only at its last residue", fontsize=10)
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8); ax[2].grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------- artifacts ----------
df.to_csv("mtl3_topology_comparison.csv", index=False)

em = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="This work (AlphaFold AF-O94317-F1 v6)", evidence_type="computational/structural", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="mtl3 adopts a predictable fold",
      key_finding="mean pLDDT 49.7; 72.3% of residues below 50; no HELIX or SHEET records",
      context="AlphaFold DB model of full-length O94317",
      confidence_limitations="High confidence no globular domain is predicted; pLDDT is a disorder proxy, not proof"),
 dict(citation="This work (Foldseek 3diaa vs pdb100, afdb50, afdb-swissprot)", evidence_type="computational/structural", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="mtl3 has a structural relative that narrows its molecular function",
      key_finding="self-hit only (E 7.5e-53); best non-self prob 0.353/E 2.5 afdb50, 0.082/E 6.3 afdb-swissprot, 0.040/E 9.1 pdb100",
      context="Foldseek web server, three databases",
      confidence_limitations="A negative is expected for a disordered query and cannot alone exclude a fold"),
 dict(citation="This work (InterPro API HTTP 204, MobiDB API, SEG)", evidence_type="computational", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="mtl3 carries a recognisable domain signature",
      key_finding="zero InterPro signatures from any member database; MobiDB AlphaFold disorder 0.993; SEG low complexity 0.82",
      context="UniProt O94317",
      confidence_limitations="Direct database result; member databases underrepresent fungal cell wall mannoproteins"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt sequence, Kyte-Doolittle, De Groot omega consensus)", evidence_type="computational", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="mtl3 is a GPI-anchored Ser/Thr-rich secretory protein",
      key_finding="Ser 48.5%, Thr 10.5%, S+T 59.0% (62.6% over 23-500); charged 6.4%; zero Trp and zero Cys in the mature chain; hydrophobic only at 5-17 and 514-534; omega candidates 509-GAS and 510-ASS; 0 residues after the C-terminal hydrophobic tail",
      context="UniProt O94317, 534 aa",
      confidence_limitations="Prediction, not experiment; omega site position approximate"),
 dict(citation="This work (topology panel, 11 proteins, KD w=11 last-40 scan)", evidence_type="computational/comparative", stance="refutes",
      claim_tested="mtl3 is a Mid2/Mtl1-like cell wall integrity sensor",
      key_finding="0 residues follow the mtl3 C-terminal hydrophobic peak, inside the GPI range (0-13) and outside the CWI sensor range (24-270); Mann-Whitney GPI < sensor p=0.0040",
      context="S. pombe and S. cerevisiae reference proteins",
      confidence_limitations="n=5 per class; hydropathy-based topology, not experimental topology mapping"),
 dict(citation="This work (BLAST-style neighborhood search, 25,166 Schizosaccharomyces proteins)", evidence_type="structural/evolutionary", stance="refutes",
      claim_tested="conserved surface patches can be mapped across fungal orthologs",
      key_finding="self HSP 328; best non-self 53 against background mean 23.8 sd 5.9; top hits are unrelated housekeeping proteins; UniRef50/90/100 singletons",
      context="all five Schizosaccharomyces reference proteomes",
      confidence_limitations="Search used residues 23-85, the sole non-repetitive region; an ortholog sharing only the low-complexity body would be missed"),
 dict(citation="PMID:12845604", evidence_type="computational (source of the GO:0009897 TAS)", stance="supports",
      claim_tested="mtl3 is GPI anchored",
      key_finding="genome-wide GPI prediction assigns SPBC215.13 a GPI anchor; cited for the PomBase GPI modification (ISS) and for GO:0009897",
      context="fungal genome-wide prediction",
      confidence_limitations="A computational prediction cited under TAS; evidence code review warranted"),
 dict(citation="PMID:16823372", evidence_type="localization", stance="competing",
      claim_tested="mtl3 localises to the endoplasmic reticulum (source of IEA GO:0005783)",
      key_finding="ORFeome localisation by C-terminal YFP fusion; a 3' tag deletes the GPI signal, so ER retention is the expected artifact for a GPI protein",
      context="S. pombe, C-terminal YFP, live imaging",
      confidence_limitations="Tag position invalidates the inference for GPI proteins specifically"),
 dict(citation="PMID:27337501", evidence_type="review", stance="refutes",
      claim_tested="mtl3 is a Mid2/Mtl1-like sensor, as its product name implies",
      key_finding="CWI sensors are defined by a single TM plus a cytoplasmic tail that recruits Rho GEFs; mtl3 has neither",
      context="review of fungal CWI signalling",
      confidence_limitations="Review-level orientation; the topology comparison is this work"),
 dict(citation="PMID:23907979", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="the S. pombe CWI sensor set includes mtl3",
      key_finding="that study tested Wsc1 and Mtl2 only; mtl3 was never assayed",
      context="S. pombe genetics",
      confidence_limitations="Absence of testing, not evidence of absence of function"),
 dict(citation="PMID:37787768 / PMID:23697806 / PMID:34250083 (PomBase PHAF)", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="qualifies",
      claim_tested="loss of mtl3 produces a cell wall integrity defect",
      key_finding="13 rows, all mtl3delta: viable, normal morphology; only SDS/salt, EGTA, oxidant, cycloheximide, ethanol and lithium responses; no cell wall drug sensitivity, no lysis, no Pmk1 or Rho1 phenotype",
      context="S. pombe deletion mutant, growth assays and microscopy",
      confidence_limitations="Deletion phenotypes are downstream; redundancy with 5 paralogous cell wall proteins untested"),
 dict(citation="STRING / BioGRID (database)", evidence_type="review/database", stance="refutes",
      claim_tested="mtl3 and mtl2 are functional partners or paralogs",
      key_finding="single STRING partner mtl2, combined 0.582 entirely from text-mining 0.570 with experimental 0.000; composition-controlled Smith-Waterman ranks mtl2 second worst of six comparators (Z 2.12 vs ScMtl1 8.42)",
      context="database carry-over from the shared former symbol mtl1",
      confidence_limitations="Text-mining association reflects nomenclature history, not data"),
])
em.to_csv("mtl3_evidence_matrix.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nwrote mtl3_evidence_matrix.csv ({len(em)} rows), mtl3_topology_comparison.csv ({len(df)} rows)")
